snippet.title: Elta: Defy All Gods - Demo Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

You play Victus, a warrior stranded on a hostile planet, who fights alongside Elta, a dragon-god companion whose restored power may be the only way home. This action platformer comes from Afterburner Studios, the team behind Dreamscaper, and launches February 2, 2027. A demo is available now.
